sources.title: Frozen Flame Admin Commands - Legion Hosting

notes: Command text comes from the developer's own server repo (DreamsideInteractive/FrozenFlameServer, RCON.commands). The Steam community guide and the Legion Hosting KB list exactly the same set and read as copies of that file, so this is effectively ONE independent source - hence confidence low. Transport: Valve Source RCON wire protocol; the official README points admins at mcrcon and says the password must be sent as "admin:<Rcon Password>", i.e. the literal prefix "admin:" is part of the auth string, not the password. RCON port and password are launch arguments (-RconPort=27015 -RconPassword=...), not ini settings; 27015 is the value in the publisher's own example launcher line, and the README's port list gives 27015 TCP for RCON, 25575 + 27015/udp for query, 7777 for game. Ban duration is in SECONDS (Admin_Ban <PlayerID> <Seconds> <Reason>); 'reason' is the trailing argument and the docs show it unquoted. Admin_ChatMessage is the only broadcast; there is no MOTD command. Bans and unbans are live commands - no documented ban file. UNRESOLVED: no published source states what PlayerID actually looks like. Admin_GetOnlinePlayers is documented only as 'Displays names and IDs of currently joined players' and no example output exists anywhere public. The game ships EasyAntiCheat/EOS but is Steam-only, so the id is plausibly a 17-digit SteamID64 or a 32-char hex EOS product user id; the pattern here is deliberately permissive to accept either, and playerParse.linePattern is a best-effort guess at a 'name then id' line. Both MUST be checked against a live server before the roster, kick or ban are trusted.
